# BuzzFeed News

> BuzzFeed News combines breaking news, original investigative reporting, and cultural analysis across politics, entertainment, science, and global affairs.

BuzzFeed News was a digital-first news outlet known for rigorous investigative journalism alongside entertainment and cultural coverage. The site operated from 2012 until its closure in 2023, leaving behind a legacy of original reporting and innovative storytelling across multiple beats.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- Investigative Journalism
- Original Reporting
- Political News
- Celebrity News
- Entertainment
- Pop Culture
- Viral Moments
- Social Media
- International News
- Public Health
- Tech & AI
- LGBTQ Rights
- Cultural Criticism
- Visual Journalism

## Core News & Investigations

- [BuzzFeed News Homepage](https://www.buzzfeednews.com): Breaking news, original reporting, and news analysis from BuzzFeed News
- [BuzzFeed News Investigations](https://www.buzzfeednews.com/investigations): Global investigative journalism team and major investigations
- [BuzzFeed News Final Editor's Note](https://www.buzzfeednews.com/article/karolinawaclawiak/a-final-editors-note): Final editor's note announcing BuzzFeed News closure and legacy
- [Definitive Oral History Of BuzzFeed News 2012–2023](https://www.buzzfeednews.com/article/buzzfeednews/buzzfeed-news-oral-history-2012-2023): Oral history of BuzzFeed News from founding to 2023 closure

## Politics & Government

- [BuzzFeed News Politics](https://www.buzzfeednews.com/section/politics): Political reporting on elections, legislation, and congressional news
- [BuzzFeed News National](https://www.buzzfeednews.com/section/national): National political news, government policy, and public health coverage

## Entertainment & Culture

- [BuzzFeed News Arts & Entertainment](https://www.buzzfeednews.com/section/arts-entertainment): Arts & entertainment coverage with celebrity news and viral moments
- [BuzzFeed News Celeb](https://www.buzzfeednews.com/section/celebrity): Celebrity news, interviews, and social media reactions
- [BuzzFeed News Culture & Criticism](https://www.buzzfeednews.com/section/culture): Cultural criticism, entertainment news, and viral content analysis
- [BuzzFeed News Internet Culture](https://www.buzzfeednews.com/section/internet-culture): Internet culture, social media trends, and viral moments coverage
- [BuzzFeed News Books](https://www.buzzfeednews.com/section/books): Book recommendations, reviews, and literary culture coverage
- [Opinion](https://www.buzzfeednews.com/collection/opinion): Opinion essays and cultural criticism on entertainment and politics

## World News & Human Rights

- [BuzzFeed News World](https://www.buzzfeednews.com/section/world): World news with international stories, human rights, and breaking news
- [LGBTQ Rights](https://www.buzzfeednews.com/topic/lgbtq-rights): LGBTQ rights coverage including activism and discrimination issues
- [BuzzFeed News Inequality](https://www.buzzfeednews.com/section/inequality): Reporting on economic inequality, worker rights, and poverty

## Science, Health & Business

- [BuzzFeed News Science](https://www.buzzfeednews.com/section/science): Science and health reporting on vaccines, diseases, and medical news
- [BuzzFeed News Health](https://www.buzzfeednews.com/section/health): Health coverage including COVID-19, mental health, and wellness trends
- [BuzzFeed News Tech](https://www.buzzfeednews.com/section/tech): Tech news covering social media, AI, and digital culture trends
- [BuzzFeed News Business](https://www.buzzfeednews.com/section/business): Business reporting on corporate misconduct, labor rights, and finance

## Visual Journalism

- [BuzzFeed News JPG](https://www.buzzfeednews.com/section/jpg): Visual journalism, photo galleries, and weekly photo roundups
